description: Live Google organic results for one keyword: position, title, URL, domain and snippet, plus which SERP features appear (AI Overview, People Also Ask, local pack, video...) and the AI Overview text. Optionally give target_domain to get that domain's best position (rank check). Billed per 10 results of depth.

country.description: 2-letter country code (US, GB, DE...) or English name. Default US.

depth.description: Results to fetch: 10-100 (default 10). Deeper is slower (100 takes ~15 s).

language.description: Language code, e.g. en, es, de. Default en.

target_domain.description: Optional domain to find in the results, e.g. example.com.

name: google_serp
title: Google search results (live SERP)
